serverInfo.name: smklog-quotes
serverInfo.title: SMKlog Parcel Shipping Rates
serverInfo.description: Live USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express shipping rates for a parcel sent from a US address — inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia — described in plain words. No scale, no account and no API key. Also reports how a checkout it prepared is going, tracks shipments bought on SMKlog and serves a monthly US parcel shipping price index.

instructions: Five tools. get_parcel_quote returns live shipping rates for a single parcel sent from a US origin — inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia — across USPS, UPS and FedEx (plus DHL Express to Germany and Australia), from a plain-words item description (or exact dimensions). create_checkout_link turns one shipment into a prefilled checkout URL where the human pays for the shipping label; hand it the quote_id from get_parcel_quote and it reuses that quote instead of spending a second carrier call, and it returns a session_id. get_checkout_status takes that session_id and reports whether the human has paid and whether the label exists, with the tracking number once it does. track_parcel reports delivery status and scan events for a shipment whose label was bought on smklog.com. get_price_index returns the monthly SMKlog parcel shipping price index (a six-box basket priced to five US cities) for reference answers — reading it spends no quote allowance. Quotes are rate limited and cost real money to produce — call get_parcel_quote once per shipment, not per variation. Oversized or palletized shipments are priced by a person: declare the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension and get_parcel_quote returns a task handle you can poll with tasks/get for the human answer. Prices are checkout totals with the SMKlog fee inside, and the carrier cost is returned separately so you can always show both. Labels are purchased at https://smklog.com/assets/calculator.
